{{Top|leg}}
The '''NRI Security Files''' were a collection of classified data kept by the [[New Republic Intelligence Service|Intelligence Service]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], known as the NRI. Those files were most secret, and any unauthorized review or receipt was considered a "class one offense", with a twenty-five [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[Prison/Legends|incarceration]] penalty and a 500,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|standard credits]] fine.
